name: Responsive, Accessibility & Performance Hardening
upstream_commits: a59bcab feat: complete Core-2 UI phase UI-5 prototype / live UI convergence
implemented_behavior: Responsive Layout Hardening: Guaranteed zero horizontal viewport overflows from 320px to ultrawide displays through fluid flex/grid layouts, responsive scroll containers, word-break boundaries, and touch scrolling.

WCAG 2.2 AA Focus Rings: Enforced 2px high-contrast visible focus rings across all interactive controls (button, input, select, textarea, links, role=button, role=checkbox, role=tab) with brand color and 2px offset.

WCAG 2.2 AA Touch Targets: Enforced >=44px touch targets on web mobile viewports and >=48px touch targets across all native mobile components (ShiftStatusCard, HeavyCraneDriveModeModal, HandoverTab, MaintenanceWorkOrderTab, field-header, notifications-sheet, profile-sheet, LoginScreen, JobDetailScreen, EquipmentInspectionScreen).
WCAG 2.2 AA Text Contrast: Guaranteed >=4.5:1 text contrast for all body and badge typography, specifically updating danger badges to use text-danger-strong on soft background.
prefers-reduced-motion Support: Enforced instantaneous animation and transition durations (0.001ms) and single iteration count in CSS, paired with useReducedMotion() hooks in motion components.
ARIA Semantics: Hardened ARIA attributes across navigation and interactive modals (aria-haspopup, aria-expanded, aria-controls, role=dialog, aria-modal, aria-label).
Bundle Optimization: Verified that MapLibre GL is completely isolated as an on-demand dynamic chunk (maplibre-gl-*.js, 252kB gzip) without blocking initial application load.

Automated Accessibility Test Suite: Expanded tests/Browser/accessibility.spec.ts with multi-viewport AxeBuilder test suites covering unauthenticated sign-in (320px, 390px, desktop) and authenticated operations workspaces.
